authority: Assignment7 eight required dimensions; S1/S2 inform questions, not a validated instrument
decision_rule: No weighted average. A known scope-critical gap blocks that scope; a critical unknown requests evidence rather than inventing pass/fail. Supported organizational conditions do not prove task performance or authorize adoption.

domains.name: Leadership and sponsorship
domains.question: Who backs the scoped activity and accepts its residual risk?

domains.name: Skills and training
domains.question: Who can review errors/abstentions and has demonstrated the required competence?

domains.name: Workflow and process
domains.question: Where do source checks, human approval, exceptions and fallback occur?

domains.name: Infrastructure and data
domains.question: Which model/data/environment/tool scope is actually authorized and traceable?

domains.name: Resources and budget
domains.question: What protected review/support time and prospective funding cover steady-state and peaks?
domains.proposed_owner_role: Proposed reporting manager and budget owner

domains.name: Governance and risk
domains.question: Who can approve, stop, log incidents, review changes and accept residual risk?

domains.name: Culture and change
domains.question: Do affected users understand the task, have a feedback route and accept the workflow?
domains.proposed_owner_role: Proposed change lead and affected reviewers

domains.name: Operating ownership
domains.question: Who owns ongoing service, reviewer cover, incidents, changes and retirement?
